title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12504__PART_2_)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12504__PART_2_) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12504__PART_2_). This text of ISO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
